baselineAdditions: availability probing is separated from pure geometry planning
pending current-line panes are retained by registration identity rather than pane key
responsive fractions use the full body axis and round before bounds are applied
invariants: the bundled files pane precedes native registrations
replacement ownership changes initial defaults without erasing known user choices
replacement chains resolve to the deepest open owner and survive cycles
bare pane ids resolve only inside the caller namespace
vertical panes allocate before horizontal panes while output retains registration order
minimum review bounds omit later panes deterministically
fixed panes have no divider and resizable panes reserve exactly one cell
availability failures are returned to the controller and do not mutate geometry state

nativeAdaptation.registrationIdentity: A monotonic host identity replaces JavaScript WeakSet object identity across native extension reloads.
nativeAdaptation.availability: The pure probe accepts a transport evaluator for registrations declaring available; the pane controller owns native request deadlines and failure reporting.
